name: color_mix
description: Name secondary paint colors formed by mixing two primary colors; matched control copies first input color.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
primary=['red','yellow','blue'];mix={frozenset(['red','yellow']):'orange',frozenset(['yellow','blue']):'green',frozenset(['blue','red']):'purple'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 a,b=random.sample(primary,2);noun=random.choice(['paint','pigment','watercolor']);stem=f'Mixing {a} {noun} with {b} {noun}.'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+' The resulting secondary color is', 'answer':' '+mix[frozenset([a,b])]})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+' The first color mentioned is', 'answer':' '+a})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
